name: C-130J-30 Super Hercules (Anubis mod)
summary: Free community C-130J-30 Super Hercules transport mod for DCS World by Anubis.
description: Flyable tactical airlifter with cargo and airdrop capability. Extract into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`; liveries go in `Saved Games\DCS\Liveries\Hercules`.
